frequency_question: How often do sovereign states under extreme wartime pressure successfully localise high-tech Western missile production within a tight timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes cases of wartime transfer and localisation of precision guided munitions or cruise missiles. Excludes standard small arms, basic artillery, or purely domestic unguided munitions.

cases.name: Pakistan domestic production of Al-Khalid/Babur variants with foreign tech support
Taiwan Hsiung Feng missile series domestic scaling under geopolitical threat
Ukraine domestic Vilkha/Neptune missile development and limited production

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; represents the most direct analogues for high-end domestic missile localisation under duress.
known_gaps: Extremely rare class of events due to the extreme secrecy, technology transfer hurdles, and industrial complexity of cruise missiles.
skeleton: 3 cases identified where high-tech missile manufacturing or deep integration was established under intense geopolitical or wartime urgency.
validity_reason: Technology transfer dynamics and industrial base constraints evolve slowly over decades.
